page.title: Updates
page.lead: Installed version, new release checks and a safe update: backup, images, migrations, health check and automatic rollback.

status.loadFailed: Could not load the update state.

last.failed: The update to {{to}} ({{at}}) failed and the rollback did not finish. Manual action is needed.
last.rolled_back: The update to {{to}} ({{at}}) failed. The system went back to the previous version.
last.needs_hands: Update to {{to}} ({{at}}): the migrations changed the database schema and the new version did not start. The image was not rolled back, manual action is needed: step-by-step instructions are in the run events.

banner.manual: The update executor is not connected
banner.manualBody: Studio checks releases and reports them, and the operator installs the version with the command below (Helm rolls back on `--atomic`). To make the buttons work, turn the executor on: `updater.enabled=true` in the chart values for Kubernetes, the updater service for compose (`docker compose --profile updater up -d` with UPDATER_TOKEN in .env).
banner.updaterOffline: The updater service does not answer
banner.updaterOfflineBody: Automatic installs and the update buttons do not work until it runs: `docker compose up -d updater`. Release checks and notifications still work.
banner.noBackupBody: Before an update the updater takes only a database snapshot. A full backup (files and objects) is possible once the Backups section has a destination.
banner.checkFailed: Could not ask for the release list
banner.updaterOfflineKube: Auto-install and the update buttons do not work until it runs: check the updater pod with `kubectl get pods -l app.kubernetes.io/component=updater` and its log. Release checks and notifications still work.
banner.noBackupKube: No backup will be taken before the update, and the database cannot be rolled back
banner.noBackupKubeBody: There is no database snapshot in Kubernetes. Set up a destination in Backups (and keep the full backup enabled in the policy): then a backup runs before the update. Without it a manual update needs the risk confirmed, and auto-install does not start.

downgrade.succeeded: Rolled back from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{at}}). Automatic installs are paused if they were on.
downgrade.rolled_back: The rollback to {{to}} ({{at}}) did not come up. The system is back on {{from}}, nothing is lost. The reason is in the log.
downgrade.failed: The rollback to {{to}} ({{at}}) did not finish. Manual action is needed: the steps are in the run log.
downgrade.cancelled: The rollback to {{to}} ({{at}}) was not performed and nothing was changed.

version.title: Version
version.lead: What is installed, what is out and when the system installs it by itself.
version.noDigest: This release publishes no image digest: a verified update will not pass. Turn image verification off in the policy or wait for the next release.
version.rollbackBlocked: The image rollback is unavailable: the update changed the database schema and the previous version does not start on the new one. Restore the database from a backup by hand.

policy.title: Policy and window
policy.lead: How the system learns about releases and whether it installs them. Window times are UTC. The window applies to automatic installs.

hint.off: Releases are not checked, no notifications.
hint.notify: We check the stable channel and notify admins; you install with the button.
hint.auto: We install by ourselves in the maintenance window, with a backup and automatic rollback.

bump.label: Largest step without a human
bump.hint: Anything bigger (for example a new major version) is notify-only.

backup.label: Full backup before updating
backup.hint: When Backups has a destination, the update waits for its successful backup. The updater always takes a database snapshot.

hint.digest: The pulled image digest must equal the one published with the release.
hint.cosign: Also checks the cosign signature (GitHub OIDC) of the publish workflow.
hint.none: Only for closed mirrors and forks: a swapped image goes unnoticed.

history.title: History
history.lead: Updates and rollbacks with their outcome. The step-by-step log opens with the Log button.

confirmUpdate.title: Update to {{version}}?
confirmUpdate.body: The updater takes a database snapshot, pulls and verifies the image, applies migrations and restarts the services. If the new version does not come up, the system goes back by itself.
confirmUpdate.downtime: The Studio is unavailable during migrations and restart, usually 1-3 minutes. Running builds are interrupted.
confirmUpdate.bodyKube: The updater checks the image, stops the api, applies the migrations in a Job and starts the new version. If it does not come up while the schema is unchanged, the previous image is put back.
confirmUpdate.schemaKube: If the migrations managed to change the database schema, the image is not rolled back (the previous one does not start on the new schema): the run ends as "Needs hands" with instructions.
confirmUpdate.acceptRisk: I understand: there will be no full backup and the database cannot be rolled back
confirmUpdate.backupsAccepted: Backups are off on purpose, reason: {{reason}}
confirmUpdate.notesNone: There are no notes for this release.

confirmRollback.title: Roll back to {{version}}?
confirmRollback.body: We bring back the images of the previous version.
confirmRollback.dataLoss: The update changed the database schema, so the rollback restores the snapshot taken before it. Everything written after the update is lost.
confirmRollback.noDataLoss: The database schema did not change: data stays as is.

failure.executor_unavailable: The built-in executor is off: update with the operator command.
failure.updater_offline: The updater does not answer: start the updater service.
failure.unknown_version: This version is not in the release list.
failure.not_cancellable: The updater has already taken the run.
failure.rate_limited: Too many requests, try again later.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.
failure.risk_not_confirmed: Confirm the risk: there will be no backup before the update.
failure.rollback_unsafe: Rollback is impossible: the update changed the database schema and the previous version cannot run on it.
failure.schema_incompatible: Rollback refused: that version needs a different database schema. Nothing was changed.
failure.digest_missing: That release publishes no image digest, so the image cannot be verified: turn verification off in the policy or pick another version.
failure.updater_outdated: The updater is older than the Studio and cannot roll back to a chosen version: update it together with the chart.

auto.title: Automatic installs
auto.lead: When it is on, the Studio installs new versions by itself in the maintenance window. When it is off, nothing is installed by itself, but release checks and notifications keep working.
auto.label: Install updates automatically

hint.on: On: new versions are installed in the maintenance window, with a backup and automatic rollback.
hint.paused: Off: nothing is installed by itself. The Studio still checks for releases and notifies administrators; install with the button.
hint.off: Release checks are off in the policy below, so there is nothing to install or announce.

auto.manualOnly: This installation updates by hand, so the switch is not available.

versions.title: Versions
versions.lead: Published releases (image digest and signature are verified as for an update). You can go back to an earlier version only if it runs on the current database schema.
versions.noDigest: The release publishes no image digest: turn verification off in the policy to use it.

compat.incompatible: works on schema {{revision}}, the database is at {{current}}: rollback is not possible
compat.unknown: this version was not run here: the updater checks the schema before stopping anything

why.manual: This installation updates by hand: roll back with Helm or by hand.
why.offline: The updater does not answer, so rollback is unavailable.
why.outdated: The updater is older than the Studio and cannot roll back to a chosen version: update it together with the chart (helm upgrade).

confirmDowngrade.title: Roll back to {{version}}?
confirmDowngrade.body: The Studio goes from {{current}} back to {{version}}. This is an image rollback only: the database schema is not changed.
confirmDowngrade.downtime: The Studio is unavailable during the swap, usually 1-3 minutes. Running builds are interrupted.

schema.compatible: The version runs on the current database schema ({{revision}}): data stays as is.
schema.incompatible: The version needs a different schema ({{revision}}): the rollback will be refused.
schema.unknown: Nothing is stopped until the updater has checked that the version fits the current database schema. If it does not, the rollback is refused and nothing changes.

confirmDowngrade.backupYes: A full backup is taken first and the rollback waits for its success.
confirmDowngrade.backupNo: No backup destination is configured (or the backup is off in the policy): only the database snapshot of the updater is taken. Set up a destination in Backups first if you want a full backup.
confirmDowngrade.backupNoKube: No backup destination is configured (or the backup is off in the policy), and Kubernetes has no database snapshot. The schema is not changed by this rollback, but a backup in Backups is still worth taking first.
confirmDowngrade.pausesAuto: After a successful rollback automatic installs are switched off, otherwise the newer version would come back in the next window. Turn them on again when you are ready.

progress.heading: {{kind}} {{from}} → {{to}}
progress.keepOpen: You can close this page: progress is recorded on the server.
progress.queued: The run is waiting for the updater to pick it up.
progress.waitingBackup: A full backup is being taken before the update.
progress.silent: The updater has not reported for a while. The status is unknown: check the installed version and the updater service.
progress.frozen: The server is not responding; the screen shows the last known data. It will refresh by itself once the server is back.

recovery.rollback: Rolling back to the previous version
recovery.restore: Restoring the database from the snapshot

pull.title: Image download
pull.running: Pulling the image for {{time}}: on a slow link this takes up to 10 minutes

health.title: Health check
health.running: Waiting for readiness for {{time}}: the service must answer without gaps for 20 seconds

restart.title: The application is restarting
restart.body: This can take up to {{minutes}} minutes: the image is pulled, migrations are applied, the service passes its readiness check. The page polls by itself and will show the result.
restart.bodyGeneric: The server is not responding. The page retries by itself and will show data once it is back.
restart.slowCompose: Longer than usual. Check on the host: docker compose ps and docker compose logs api.
restart.slowKube: Longer than usual. Check in the cluster: kubectl get pods, kubectl describe pod for api, and the namespace events.
restart.back: The application is responding again. Downtime: {{time}}.

outcome.supportHint: Technical details without tokens, addresses or paths. Copy them and attach to your request.

failureRollback.failed: The rollback to {{to}} did not finish: manual action is needed
failureRollback.cancelled: The rollback to {{to}} was cancelled, nothing was changed

image_pull.title: The image could not be downloaded
image_pull.body: The node or host could not get the new version image from the registry.
image_pull.hint: Check access to the registry (network, DNS, rate limits, pull secret) and retry. The system was not changed.

image_not_found.title: The image was not found by its tag
image_not_found.body: The registry has no image for this version: the release was published incompletely or the tag was removed.
image_not_found.hint: Wait a few minutes after the release and retry, or pick another version. The system was not changed.

no_permission.title: The executor has no rights in the cluster
no_permission.hint: Check the updater Role and RoleBinding (the updater.enabled flag in Helm) and retry.

rollout_timeout.title: The rollout did not finish in time
rollout_timeout.body: The service did not stop or become ready within the allowed time.
rollout_timeout.hint: Check the api pod events and logs: the image is still pulling, resources are short, or the pod fails its probe. If all is well, retry.

migration_failed.title: The database migration failed
migration_failed.body: The new version could not bring the database schema up to its own.
migration_failed.hint: See the executor message and the migration Job log. If the schema has changed, contact support before rolling back: the previous version does not start on a newer schema.

health_failed.title: The health check failed
health_failed.body: The new version started but did not become healthy: the container crashes or restarts.
health_failed.hint: Check the api logs. If a rollback was done, the system is on the previous version; if not, follow the manual-action message.

digest.title: The image failed the digest check
digest.body: The image digest was not found or did not match the one published with the release.
digest.hint: For a release without a digest, knowingly choose the "No verification" mode (closed mirrors) or install by hand. The system was not changed.

signature_invalid.title: The image signature is not confirmed
signature_invalid.hint: Do not install this image. Check the mirror and the verification settings, then retry. The system was not changed.

schema_blocked.title: The version does not match the database schema
schema_blocked.body: The database schema differs from the image version, so the run was cancelled or the image cannot be rolled back.
schema_blocked.hint: Update forward. Returning to this version is only possible by restoring the database from a backup.

needs_hands.title: Manual action is needed
needs_hands.body: The image was not rolled back: migrations changed the database schema and the new version did not come up. The previous version cannot start on the new schema.
needs_hands.hint: Find the cause in the journal and fix forward, or restore the backup taken before the update.

rollback_failed.title: The rollback failed
rollback_failed.body: The update did not go through and the previous version could not be restored automatically.
rollback_failed.hint: Manual action is needed: the steps and the snapshot location are in the run journal. Then check the installed version.

unknown_outcome.title: The status is unknown, check the version
unknown_outcome.body: The updater stopped responding or restarted in the middle of the update, and its journal is incomplete. Success is not confirmed.
unknown_outcome.hint: Check the installed version and the services. If the version is new and everything works, the update went through; if not, retry.

updater_offline.title: The updater did not pick up the run
updater_offline.body: The updater service did not respond; the run was cancelled before any work.
updater_offline.hint: Start the updater service and retry. The system was not changed.

backup_failed.title: The backup before the update failed
backup_failed.body: The full backup did not finish, so the update never started.
backup_failed.hint: Fix the backup in the Backups section and retry. The system was not changed.

disk_space.title: Not enough space or the database snapshot failed
disk_space.body: The database snapshot before the update could not be taken.
disk_space.hint: Free some space (the Storage section) and retry. The system was not changed.

cancelled.title: The run was cancelled
cancelled.body: The run was stopped before any work started.
cancelled.hint: Nothing was changed. Start the update again when needed.

cluster_unavailable.title: The cluster did not accept the change
cluster_unavailable.body: The api Deployment could not be read or changed.
cluster_unavailable.hint: Check that the cluster API is reachable and the Deployment is healthy, then retry.

environment.title: The environment does not fit the update
environment.body: The executor did not find the services, volumes or options it knows how to carry over.
environment.hint: Check the updater settings and the installation layout, or update by hand following the documentation.

no_previous.title: Nothing to roll back to
no_previous.body: The updater has no record, image or snapshot of the previous version.
no_previous.hint: Install the needed version with a manual update.

bad_version.title: The version was not accepted
bad_version.body: The executor rejected the version string.
bad_version.hint: Pick a version from the release list.

internal.title: Internal executor error
internal.body: The executor hit an unexpected error.
internal.hint: Copy the details for support and check the installed version: it may not have changed.

unknown.title: The update did not finish
unknown.hint: Open the journal and the details for support.
